response.justification: Bogdan possesses exceptional experience in geospatial data processing through his work on GISCollective and Green Map, alongside a proven track record of building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. However, his recent technical stack leans heavily towards TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with his C++ experience dating back to 2015 and no mention of Rust. While his strong engineering fundamentals and systems programming background suggest he could adapt, the lack of recent modern C++ or Rust experience makes him a borderline candidate for a role where these are the primary languages. A screening interview is recommended to gauge his willingness and ability to transition to C++ or Rust.
strengths: Extensive experience with geospatial data processing and building GIS platforms (GISCollective, Green Map).
Proven ability to build low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems, handling millions of requests per second.
Strong software craftsmanship practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and full-stack engineering capabilities.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with modern C++ or Rust, which are the primary technologies for the role.
Most recent professional roles are heavily focused on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than lower-level data pipelines.
No direct mention of building specific routing or navigation guidance algorithms, despite general GIS experience.
